notes: R61 defines the pricing configuration rule as a foundational requirement for authorized users to define and manage rental pricing structures. The core operative rules are well-established across primary evidence (E1, E5, E7). However, significant gaps exist around precision handling, multi-currency behavior, and the relationship between displayed and persisted values. E3 and E4 highlight unresolved concerns from Finance and QA about whether currency presentation simplifications can diverge from underlying financial records. E9 signals an active multi-currency conversion rule conflict that must be resolved. The requirement depends on related rules (R62 for rental cost calculation) and implementations (I61, I63, I64) but those dependencies do not override the core pricing configuration scope.
